findings.scenario: An A mutation remains in flight, logout/login replaces credentials with B, then the A request receives 401. Request refresh uses B refresh token and replays the A payload with B Authorization and B tenant header. Tenant-scoped settings routes resolve the destination from these current credentials.
findings.expected: Reject the superseded operation and preserve B session; same-session concurrent refresh still retries once.
findings.actual: Adapter recorded first Bearer token-A / tenant-A, then Bearer token-B-refreshed / tenant-B with identical storage config payload; refresh used refresh-B.
findings.provenance: request.ts differs from both 74434f730 and d4fadf402 only in brand storage keys/comments; retry logic predates remediation. Blame bd6c4a9b96, original 401 gate 81bd2e6c2c.

remediation.behavior: Capture a request session generation and selected tenant before first dispatch. Unknown token replacement advances the generation; successful shared refresh preserves it. Verify identity before refreshing, after refresh, and in retry interceptor. Reuse already-rotated same-session tokens. Preserve Axios cancellation and let each AbortSignal waiter reject without canceling shared refresh.

findings.scenario: Select preview A, then B before A fetch completes. B resolves first, A resolves last.
findings.expected: B content remains under B filename; old request cannot set loading/error/blob/render state.
findings.actual: Active knowledgeId B, rendered text A-stale after B-current had rendered.
findings.provenance: Same file as d4fadf402. Main 74434f730 lacks later unrelated preview fixes, but unguarded fetch/load flow is inherited (ceb4d1a310 / 270b64f6ec).

findings.scenario: The reused preview receives a different sourceBlob whose name, MIME type and size match the previous blob.
findings.expected: New Blob identity triggers preview refresh for every format.
findings.actual: old then new both length 3 leaves old displayed; guard only compares Blob identity when loadedMermaidBlob is truthy.
findings.provenance: Same file as d4fadf402; key introduced d5cb842580, Mermaid-only identity guard a19c4ce4fd.

findings.scenario: Keep composer browser status subscribed and hide/show the browser tab several times before the existing poll timer fires.
findings.expected: One scheduled poll, no scheduled polls after last unwatch.
findings.actual: 4 visibility cycles leave 5 timers; unwatch clears only one, leaving 4 more requests scheduled. Each surviving active-chain callback repeats.
findings.provenance: Byte-identical to both 74434f730 and d4fadf402; introduced 7a98a8e3de.

findings.scenario: Build for documented VITE_BASE_PATH=/genyee/ and display resource/provider-backed image through the raw protected-file fetch pipeline. Gateway serves only prefixed routes.
findings.actual: GET /files?file_path=... drops prefix and returns gateway 404; image hidden. Unlike Axios and sandbox websocket builders, hydration never applies API base.
findings.provenance: Existing behavior from main/chore, not residue renaming.
